questionText: What is @ControllerAdvice and how do you handle exceptions globally in Spring Boot?

target.learningOutcome: The learner can explain shared MVC exception handling, local-versus-global precedence, and a safe ProblemDetail response for a domain failure.

claims.statement: @ControllerAdvice shares @ExceptionHandler, @InitBinder, and @ModelAttribute methods across selected controllers; @RestControllerAdvice also supplies response-body behavior.
Spring MVC checks applicable local @ExceptionHandler methods before matching handlers declared in controller advice, then continues through its resolver chain when none matches.
Spring MVC can return ProblemDetail from an exception handler and serialize it with the problem-details media type while preserving RFC 9457 title, status, detail, and extension members.
Controller advice handles exceptions that reach Spring MVC controller processing; authentication-filter failures and background-task failures require handling in their own execution layers.

examples.title: Map one order-domain exception to a verified ProblemDetail response

validation.command: Run gold.q5.ControllerAdviceTest with Java 17, Spring Boot 3.3.1, the advice registered in standalone MockMvc
validation.expected: GET /orders/99 returns 404 application/problem+json with the expected title, detail, and errorCode

visuals.title: Local exception handler before advice and the remaining resolver chain

notes: The compact decision diagram parsed and rendered in headless Chrome at a 527 by 619 viewBox with six nodes.

review.notes: Controller-advice selection and ProblemDetail behavior were checked against official Spring documentation and RFC 9457; the focused error contract passed. This record is not editorially approved.
